mappings.rationale: Held-out profile shows 11-digit ABN strings with spaces (e.g. '59 283 578 741'); the abn transform validates checksum and formatting. Ownership is not established by the source (may be individual's ABN), so confidence is kept below the prior 0.9 and flagged. Not a buyer or agency identifier. Rows with failing checksums should be rejected, not coerced.

Held-out values are 9-digit ACN strings with spaces (e.g. '105 317 682'); acn transform validates checksum. Sparse (36 of 3000 non-empty), so coverage is poor; retained at threshold only with checksum validation. Not derived from ABN.

Single-line free-text address labelled as business address; maps to full address only. Locality, state and postcode are embedded and not split, to avoid unreliable parsing. Address may be residential or c/- mailing address.

unmapped_fields.reason: Previous mapping to entity.legal_name at confidence 0.6 is below the 0.8 minimum and is not supported as a registered legal name: most rows are individual persons (Licence Type DESC = Individual). Removed from mappings; no defensible legal_name evidence. Could be considered for a person-level entity role in future.
